title: MV UI spacing issue after removing HP/MP/TP bars

posts.author: Solarae
posts.body:
I’m working on a small UI tweak in RPG Maker MV and could use a bit of help. I’m pretty new to JavaScript and have mostly been using premade plugins (like Yanfly). I couldn’t really find one that does exactly what I wanted for this case, so I tried putting something together myself.
(I couldn't figure out a way to fix it with the Yanfly plugins I have, but if anyone knows one from Yanfly that can do what I need without this plugin I tried making, that could be great too. Not sure if I'm missing anything that they offer.)
So far, I’ve been able to remove the HP/MP/TP gauges with:
Window_Base.prototype.drawGauge = function() {};
That part works fine. Now I’m trying to keep the HP/MP/TP text visible (going for a more classic Final Fantasy-style layout), but adjust the spacing so the labels sit closer to the actual numbers.
Right now everything feels a bit off... the labels sit too far left compared to the values, and since the gauges are gone, the whole layout looks stretched and uneven.
My game is running at 1104x624, which I think is part of what’s causing it. I do like the widescreen look during gameplay, but the menu UI doesn’t quite line up nicely where the bars used to be.
I was also wondering if there’s a way to keep the menu itself at 816x624 with a black background while still running the game at 1104x624 overall. Though I’m not sure if that would break other menus like shops, since those actually look fine as they are.
Honestly, the main issue is just the HP/MP/TP text being shifted out of place. If I can nudge that closer and clean up the spacing, I’d be happy with it.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
They come from:
Window_MenuStatus.prototype.drawItemStatus
which uses (inherited from Window_Base)
drawActorSimpleStatus
which uses
drawActorHp
drawActorMp
drawActorTp
Hp and Mp use
drawCurrentAndMax
You can change x coordinate, width of drawing area and also change the
centering
(edit: aligment) from right.
If you want only one menu smaller, but keep others full screen, I think easiest is just to change window x and widths in the methods that create them.
